What it solves: Reached from a QA rule_proposal (scope `project`, 2026-08-23): "coordinator sweep should flag an active/ ticket whose commit is already ancestor of origin/main with no matching QA sent-notify, and nudge QA to resend." Accepted in substance and minted as this ticket rather than appended as prose to …
Approval context: Firm: the state is real and currently unobserved. Five tickets have reached it, and BL-1030 is sitting in it right now - QA landed it (fd5da2686 "Merge origin/main into QA-approved BL-1030 (3b5e2f7a13) for landing"), there is no close commit, and the file is still in backlog/active/.
Your call on O…
BL-1104 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1104" (or "reject BL-1104 <reason>") to act.
